raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 is the only UTC-sourced delivery (source_tz='UTC', 377 rows, the same count as the UTC rows), but its txn_ts is stored in UTC while the other batches are America/Chicago local time. Those rows are therefore 6 hours ahead of local time, which pushes about 102 transactions that are really 18:00-24:00 local on 2026-01-17 into 00:00-06:00 on 2026-01-18. Converting UTC-sourced timestamps to local time (UTC-6, since January is CST) before deriving txn_date should correct the silver and gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') t;"}}
